_comment: Versioned standard action catalogue (MAINTENANCE_ACTION_CATALOG_PATH). Findings map to ordered action codes; the analysis offers at most 3 distinct candidates in finding order, the model may choose which one is the primary suggestion, and the text is never rewritten. Bump 'version' on every change.

actions.detector.onsite_inspection: 安排授权人员现场核查探测器及周边辐射环境
actions.detector.verify_rainfall_context: 核对同期降雨、方舱温湿度和周边作业记录
actions.detector.compare_neighbors: 对比相邻站点同时段剂量率，排除区域性变化
actions.detector.check_high_voltage: 复核探测器高压、自检记录和通信状态
actions.detector.fault_diagnosis: 查看设备自检与故障代码，必要时安排检修
actions.detector.check_acquisition: 检查采集程序与探测器输出，确认读数是否卡滞
actions.detector.verify_alarm_record: 核对设备报警记录与读数，确认报警原因
actions.backup.check_mains_supply: 核查外部交流供电恢复情况，评估剩余续航
actions.backup.check_charging_path: 检查充电模块、接线和实际负载
actions.backup.capacity_test: 安排受控容量测试，评估是否需要更换蓄电池
actions.backup.compare_recovery: 对比市电恢复后的充电过程与历史基线，持续观察恢复情况
actions.history.review_previous_events: 调阅同设备历史事件与人工审核结论，评估是否升级检修
